title: Theorem 4.3 (De Giorgi): structure of the reduced boundary
statement: For n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} open and E Lebesgue null-measurable with locally finite perimeter in U: a Gauss-Green pair (μ, ν) for (U, E) exists, and for every Gauss-Green pair (μ, ν), with ∂*E := reducedBoundary U μ ν (points of U where the open-ball averages μ(B_ρ(x))⁻¹∫_{B_ρ(x)}ν dμ converge as ρ ↓ 0 to a unit vector) and ν_E := reducedNormal μ ν (that limit): ∂*E is countably n-rectifiable; μ = Hⁿ⌞∂*E as measures on ℝ^{n+1}; for every x ∈ ∂*E, μ has approximate tangent plane (span{ν_E(x)})^⊥ at x with multiplicity 1 (HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity); and for every x ∈ ∂*E and compact K, L^{n+1}(K ∩ (η_{x,r}(E) Δ {y : ⟨y, ν_E(x)⟩ > 0})) → 0 as r ↓ 0.
